  "source_text": "import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error


def load_records(raw_batch: list) -> list:
    """Retain supplied records; input loading is explicit in the catalog."""
    return raw_batch


def clean_records(rows: list) -> dict:
    """Remove duplicate and incomplete pairs without changing the remaining order."""
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    unique = frame.drop_duplicates().dropna(subset=["x", "y"])
    x = unique["x"].astype(float).tolist()
    y = unique["y"].astype(float).tolist()
    return {"x": x, "y": y}


def split_records(cleaned: dict, training_rows: int) -> dict:
    """Use an explicit ordered holdout; no random split or hidden seed."""
    train_x = np.asarray(cleaned["x"][:training_rows], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1).tolist()
    test_x = np.asarray(cleaned["x"][training_rows:], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1).tolist()
    train_y = cleaned["y"][:training_rows]
    test_y = cleaned["y"][training_rows:]
    return {"train_x": train_x, "test_x": test_x, "train_y": train_y, "test_y": test_y}


def scale_features(split: dict, feature_scale: float) -> dict:
    """Apply the same supplied scale to training and holdout features."""
    train_x = (np.asarray(split["train_x"], dtype=float) * feature_scale).tolist()
    test_x = (np.asarray(split["test_x"], dtype=float) * feature_scale).tolist()
    return {"train_x": train_x, "test_x": test_x, "train_y": split["train_y"], "test_y": split["test_y"]}


def fit_coefficients(scaled: dict) -> dict:
    """Fit only training pairs, and retain source-defined rounded coefficients."""
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(scaled["train_x"], scaled["train_y"])
    coefficients = model.coef_.round(8).tolist()
    intercept = round(float(model.intercept_), 8)
    return {"coefficients": coefficients, "intercept": intercept, "test_x": scaled["test_x"], "test_y": scaled["test_y"]}


def predict_holdout(fitted: dict) -> dict:
    """Apply the fitted linear rule to held-out features."""
    predictions = (np.asarray(fitted["test_x"]) @ np.asarray(fitted["coefficients"]) + fitted["intercept"]).round(8).tolist()
    return {"predictions": predictions, "expected": fitted["test_y"]}


def evaluate_holdout(scored: dict) -> dict:
    """Report both source-defined error measures on the held-out targets."""
    mae = round(float(mean_absolute_error(scored["expected"], scored["predictions"])), 8)
    mse = round(float(mean_squared_error(scored["expected"], scored["predictions"])), 8)
    return {"mae": mae, "mse": mse, "predictions": scored["predictions"], "samples": len(scored["predictions"])}


def finish_report(metrics: dict, candidate: dict) -> dict:
    """Attach explicit candidate metadata without changing measured values."""
    return {"mae": metrics["mae"], "mse": metrics["mse"], "predictions": metrics["predictions"], "samples": metrics["samples"], "candidate": candidate["name"], "phase": candidate["phase"]}


def workflow(raw_batch: list, training_rows: int, feature_scale: float, candidate: dict) -> dict:
    """The eight steps are the authoritative source-order conversion boundary."""
    rows = load_records(raw_batch)
    cleaned = clean_records(rows)
    split = split_records(cleaned, training_rows)
    scaled = scale_features(split, feature_scale)
    fitted = fit_coefficients(scaled)
    scored = predict_holdout(fitted)
    metrics = evaluate_holdout(scored)
    report = finish_report(metrics, candidate)
    return report

  "description": "Four calls sharing a mutable buffer across two consumers; exact object identity and left-before-right effects are source semantics.",
  "package_name": "challenge_shared_mutable_fanout",
  "node_count": 4,
  "helper_asts": [
    "create_buffer",
    "read_left",
    "read_right",
    "combine"
  ],
  "memory_datasets": [
    "buffer",
    "left",
    "right"
  ],

    1,
    1,
    1,
    1
  ],
  "source_path": "input/workflow.py",
  "source_text": "def create_buffer(raw_values: list) -> dict:\n    return {\"values\":raw_values,\"events\":[]}\n\n\ndef read_left(buffer: dict, gain: float) -> dict:\n    buffer[\"events\"].append(\"left\")\n    return {\"score\":sum(buffer[\"values\"])*gain,\"buffer\":buffer}\n\n\ndef read_right(buffer: dict, bias: float) -> dict:\n    buffer[\"events\"].append(\"right\")\n    return {\"score\":sum(buffer[\"values\"])+bias,\"buffer\":buffer}\n\n\ndef combine(left: dict, right: dict) -> dict:\n    assert left[\"buffer\"] is right[\"buffer\"], \"Shared buffer identity changed\"\n    assert left[\"buffer\"][\"events\"] == [\"left\",\"right\"], \"Source call order changed\"\n    return {\"left_score\":left[\"score\"],\"right_score\":right[\"score\"],\"events\":left[\"buffer\"][\"events\"]}\n\n\ndef workflow(raw_values: list, gain: float, bias: float) -> dict:\n    buffer = create_buffer(raw_values)\n    left = read_left(buffer, gain)\n    right = read_right(buffer, bias)\n    report = combine(left, right)\n    return report\n",
  "source_lines": 26,
  "minimum_tests": 4,
  "mutation": [
    "sum(buffer[\"values\"])*gain",
    "sum(buffer[\"values\"])+gain"
  ],
  "source_package": null,
  "failure_scenarios": [],
  "expected_tool_boundary": "fanout_unsupported"
}
